author: Salt Lake Film Society
title: Seeking artist for Tower Theatre fundraising art piece
content: Salt Lake Film Society is seeking an artist to create an original piece of art celebrating the Tower Theatre's community fundraising campaign to restore and reopen Salt Lake City’s iconic movie house. The commissioned piece will be given as a thank-you gift to campaign donors and reproduced as a limited-edition poster, tote bag, and sticker. If interested, please email shaunabrock@saltlakefilmsociety.org no later than October 15. Three artists will be selected to interview for the commission the week of November 1.
